## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in scope.

## Evidence and limits

- Tests or checks run:
- Result artifacts or screenshots:
- Known limitations or untested platforms:
- Statistical assumptions or claim changes:
- Material AI-tool assistance used:

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include credentials, personal data, confidential data, or identifying local paths.
- [ ] I ran the relevant JavaScript and Python tests and reported their exact results.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behaviour where practical.
- [ ] I updated contracts, method documentation, or release evidence when the change affects them.
- [ ] I did not relabel development evidence as formal validation, adoption, certification, or public availability.
- [ ] Any HR functionality remains aggregate-only and cannot make individual employment decisions.
- [ ] Generated artifacts and dependency-lock changes are intentional and explained.
- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the MIT License.
